fidelity: F2a — Full Electrochemical Model with KOH Conductivity and Thermal ODE
source: Larminie & Dicks (2003) Fuel Cell Systems Explained 2nd Ed.; Appleby & Foulkes (1989) Fuel Cell Handbook; Gilliam et al. (2007) Int. J. Hydrogen Energy 32(3) 359-364 (KOH conductivity correlation); Kordesch & Simader (1996) Fuel Cells and Their Applications

unit.name: Generic AFC Stack (40-cell, KOH electrolyte) — Physics-Lumped Electrochemical

A_cell.note: Active cell area (typical AFC, reused from EC003 F1a)

d_electrolyte.note: Inter-electrode KOH electrolyte gap (Kordesch 1996, mobile-electrolyte AFC)

c_KOH.note: KOH electrolyte concentration (~30 wt% KOH, classic Bacon/Apollo AFC); near max-conductivity point

j_L.note: Limiting current density (AFC lower than PEMFC, liquid-electrolyte mass transport)

alpha_cathode.note: Cathode charge transfer coefficient (ORR in alkaline)

j0_cathode_ref.note: Exchange current density, Ag/Pt cathode in KOH at T_ref (Appleby 1989); higher than acidic ORR — alkaline kinetics are faster

E_act_cathode.note: Apparent activation energy for ORR in alkaline media (Appleby & Foulkes 1989)

m_stack.note: Stack thermal mass (incl. liquid KOH inventory)

cp_stack.note: Effective stack specific heat (KOH solution cp ~3000, structure ~500; mass-weighted lump)

hA_cool.note: Electrolyte-loop / coolant heat transfer coefficient * area
